notes: Riverwalk by day. The player buys the stage-mistress's dugout (150 gold), paddles towards the public cove beach, falls out and leaves it adrift, then walks back to the stage-mistress and pays her to fetch it: the fee is ceil(10% of the price), at least 5, so 15 gold for the dugout; the boat lies tied at a mooring of her place the player may use.

steps.name: buy-the-dugout
steps.transition: the stage-mistress's boat window -> Buy the dugout: 150 gold, the stage canoe turns the player's

steps.name: board
steps.transition: E at the canoe: the player steps aboard

steps.name: cast-off
steps.transition: E aboard: the canoe casts off from the landing

steps.name: paddle-out
steps.transition: W on the paddle towards the cove beach

steps.name: fall-out
steps.transition: the player goes over the side: the canoe drifts free

steps.name: save-and-load
steps.transition: save adrift and load: the boat records and the hulls come back as they were

steps.name: pay-to-fetch
steps.transition: back at the landing, the stage-mistress's boat window -> Fetch the dugout: 15 gold, the canoe comes back tied
